role: CLI adapter and transport layer between user/agent and MCP Server

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a file using MCP tools and AI.
commands.flow: bridge -> MCP server -> AI -> console output

commands.name: improve
commands.description: Improve a file with AI and write updated version to disk.

commands.name: run-recipe
commands.description: Run a Universal Agent recipe against an optional path.
commands.flow: bridge agent engine executes multi-step MCP calls

commands.name: voice-test-call
commands.description: Submit an outbound voice test call request through mcp-server. Real-call intent requires --call.
commands.flow: bridge -> MCP server -> voice.outboundCall -> console output

commands.name: voice-status
commands.description: Fetch mock voice call status through mcp-server.
commands.flow: bridge -> MCP server -> voice.getCallStatus -> console output

commands.name: voice-result
commands.description: Fetch mock voice call result through mcp-server.
commands.flow: bridge -> MCP server -> voice.getCallResult -> console output

commands.name: voice-transcribe
commands.description: Fetch manual transcription readiness state through mcp-server. Current provider default is disabled.
commands.flow: bridge -> MCP server -> voice.transcribe -> console output

commands.name: interactive
commands.description: Start interactive REPL mode to explore and call MCP tools.

invariants: Bridge exposes only CLI interfaces, no HTTP server.
All business logic lives in MCP Server, not in bridge.
Bridge forwards user intent to MCP via JSON-RPC.
Bridge may not mutate project state except via explicit commands.
AUTH_TOKEN is required for any MCP connection.
non-goals: No persistent state or memory management.
No direct filesystem scanning beyond command needs.
